versions.changelog:
Easy Travel with Child — Initial Release

- Launches a parent-friendly planning tool for stress-free family trips.
- Helps select and compare hotels with high-quality free children’s playgrounds, based on child age, gender, and personality.
- Clearly indicates if parental supervision is required at hotels and venues.
- Integrates real-time hotel and package searches (using scripts), ensuring data is always up-to-date.
- Recommends tailored nearby attractions and play venues with safety and appropriateness guides.
- Combines all results into a clear, actionable itinerary card for easier trip decisions.
